اسبغللن (form IVq)
# اِسْبَغْلَلْنَ (isbaḡlalna) /is.baɣ.lal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْبَغَلَّ (isbaḡalla)
# اِسْبَغْلِلْنَ (isbaḡlilna) /is.baɣ.lil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْبَغَلَّ (isbaḡalla)
